Both [[Skeleton|skeletal]] and [[zombie]] undead ones are found in [[Ah Za Rhoon]] and [[Rashiliyia's Tomb]], whereas the zombie undead ones are also found at the entrance to [[Shilo Village (location)|Shilo Village]]. When the zombie variant is killed, they have the chance to release a poison gas that would damage the player for 2-3 [[Hitpoints]] per hit. However, it is not poisonous, so [[antipoison]] is not required. The gas only affects characters in a one-square radius around where the undead one was when it was killed, so if players kill one, they have a few seconds to run to avoid taking damage. Asking [[Mosol Rei]] "''What danger is there around here?''" will cause at least 1 undead one to spawn. Picking up the trapped [[coins]] in [[Rashiliyia's Tomb]] will also cause multiple undead ones to spawn around the player. Prior to the completion of the Shilo Village quest, all damage dealt to undead ones is reduced by two, while the experience gained is still calculated based on the original (unreduced) damage value. Uniquely, it is therefore also possible to cause a zero damage [[hitsplat]] to appear when hitting an undead one with a spell, instead of resulting in a [[Splashing|splash]].
